installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# steamcmd Base Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Image to install with is 'ghcr.io/ptero-eggs/installers:debian'

##
#
# Variables
# STEAM_USER, STEAM_PASS, STEAM_AUTH - Steam user setup. If a user has 2fa enabled it will most likely fail due to timeout. Leave blank for anon install.
# SRCDS_APPID - steam app id found here - https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Dedicated_Servers_List
# SRCDS_BETAID - beta branch of a steam app. Leave blank to install normal branch
# SRCDS_BETAPASS - password for a beta branch should one be required during private or closed testing phases.. Leave blank for no password.
# INSTALL_FLAGS - Any additional SteamCMD  flags to pass during install.. Keep in mind that steamcmd auto update process in the docker image might overwrite or ignore these when it performs update on server boot.
# AUTO_UPDATE - Adding this variable to the egg allows disabling or enabling automated updates on boot. Boolean value. 0 to disable and 1 to enable.
#
##

## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} ${INSTALL_FLAGS} validate +quit

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

cd /mnt/server

## Create serverconfig.xml with every setting the panel exposes, if it doesn't already exist.
## 7 Days to Die only writes values the panel's find/replace can update into a line that is
## already present, so this file has to exist with every property up front for the panel
## settings to apply from the very first boot.
if [[ ! -f /mnt/server/serverconfig.xml ]]; then
cat > /mnt/server/serverconfig.xml << 'SEVENDTDXML'
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<ServerSettings>
	<!-- Server representation -->
	<property name="ServerName"						value="My Game Host"/>
	<property name="ServerDescription"				value="A 7 Days to Die server"/>
	<property name="ServerWebsiteURL"				value=""/>
	<property name="ServerPassword"					value=""/>
	<property name="ServerLoginConfirmationText"	value="" />
	<property name="Region"							value="NorthAmericaEast" />
	<property name="Language"						value="English" />
	<!-- Networking -->
	<property name="ServerPort"						value="26900"/>
	<property name="ServerVisibility"				value="2"/>
	<property name="ServerDisabledNetworkProtocols"	value="SteamNetworking"/>
	<property name="ServerMaxWorldTransferSpeedKiBs" value="512"/>
	<!-- Slots -->
	<property name="ServerMaxPlayerCount"			value="8"/>
	<property name="ServerReservedSlots"			value="0"/>
	<property name="ServerReservedSlotsPermission"	value="100"/>
	<property name="ServerAdminSlots"				value="0"/>
	<property name="ServerAdminSlotsPermission"		value="0"/>
	<!-- Crossplay / anti-cheat -->
	<property name="EACEnabled"						value="true"/>
	<property name="ServerAllowCrossplay"			value="false"/>
	<property name="IgnoreEOSSanctions"				value="false"/>
	<!-- Admin interfaces -->
	<property name="WebDashboardEnabled"			value="false"/>
	<property name="WebDashboardPort"				value="8080"/>
	<property name="EnableMapRendering"				value="false"/>
	<property name="TelnetEnabled"					value="true"/>
	<property name="TelnetPort"						value="8081"/>
	<property name="TelnetPassword"					value=""/>
	<property name="TelnetFailedLoginLimit"			value="10"/>
	<property name="TelnetFailedLoginsBlocktime"	value="10"/>
	<!-- Folder and file locations -->
	<property name="AdminFileName"					value="serveradmin.xml"/>
	<!-- Other technical settings -->
	<property name="HideCommandExecutionLog"		value="0"/>
	<property name="MaxUncoveredMapChunksPerPlayer"	value="131072"/>
	<property name="PersistentPlayerProfiles"		value="false" />
	<!-- World -->
	<property name="GameWorld"						value="Navezgane"/>
	<property name="WorldGenSeed"					value="asdf"/>
	<property name="WorldGenSize"					value="6144"/>
	<property name="GameName"						value="My Game"/>
	<property name="GameMode"						value="GameModeSurvival"/>
	<!-- Gameplay: sandbox rules (V3.0+, replaces 30 legacy per-property settings) -->
	<property name="SandboxCode"					value="AAAJABJACJADJARFBNC"/>
	<!-- Difficulty-adjacent settings that survived the SandboxCode migration -->
	<property name="PlayerSafeZoneLevel"			value="5" />
	<property name="PlayerSafeZoneHours"			value="5" />
	<property name="BuildCreate"					value="false" />
	<property name="BedrollDeadZoneSize"			value="15" />
	<property name="BedrollExpiryTime"				value="45" />
	<!-- Performance related -->
	<property name="MaxSpawnedZombies"				value="64" />
	<property name="MaxSpawnedAnimals"				value="50" />
	<property name="ServerMaxAllowedViewDistance"	value="12" />
	<!-- Multiplayer -->
	<property name="PartySharedKillRange"			value="100"/>
	<property name="PlayerKillingMode"				value="3" />
	<!-- Land claim options -->
	<property name="LandClaimCount"					value="1"/>
	<property name="LandClaimSize"					value="41"/>
	<property name="LandClaimDeadZone"				value="30"/>
	<property name="LandClaimExpiryTime"			value="7"/>
	<property name="LandClaimDecayMode"				value="0"/>
	<property name="LandClaimOnlineDurabilityModifier"	value="4"/>
	<property name="LandClaimOfflineDurabilityModifier"	value="4"/>
	<property name="LandClaimOfflineDelay"			value="0"/>
	<!-- Dynamic mesh (building collapse) -->
	<property name="DynamicMeshEnabled"				value="true"/>
	<property name="DynamicMeshLandClaimOnly"		value="true"/>
	<property name="DynamicMeshLandClaimBuffer"		value="3"/>
	<property name="DynamicMeshMaxItemCache"		value="3"/>
	<!-- Twitch integration -->
	<property name="TwitchServerPermission"			value="90"/>
	<property name="TwitchBloodMoonAllowed"			value="false"/>
</ServerSettings>
SEVENDTDXML
fi

## add below your custom commands if needed

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum concurrent players.

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: Steam app ID for the 7 Days to Die dedicated server. Do not change unless you know what you're doing.

variables.name: Automatic Updates
variables.description: Check Steam for a new version every time the server starts, and install it if one is found. 1 to enable, 0 to disable.

variables.name: Library Path
variables.description: Internal library search path the server binary needs to find its own files. Do not change.

variables.name: Beta Branch
variables.description: Installs this Steam beta branch instead of the default stable release, e.g. latest_experimental. Leave blank for stable. Requires a reinstall to switch branches.

variables.name: Telnet Port
variables.description: Port the Telnet console listens on.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name shown in the server browser.

variables.name: Server Description
variables.description: Short text shown under the server name in the browser.

variables.name: Server Website URL
variables.description: Shown in the server browser as a clickable link. Leave blank for none.

variables.name: Join Message
variables.description: Message a player must confirm before they can join. Leave blank to skip it.

variables.name: Region
variables.description: Region shown in the server browser. One of: NorthAmericaEast, NorthAmericaWest, CentralAmerica, SouthAmerica, Europe, Russia, Asia, MiddleEast, Africa, Oceania.

variables.name: Language
variables.description: Primary language for players on this server, shown in the browser (e.g. English, German, Spanish, French).

variables.name: Join Password
variables.description: Password players must enter to join. Leave blank for no password.

variables.name: Server Browser Visibility
variables.description: Who can see this server in the browser. 0 = not listed, 1 = friends only, 2 = public.

variables.name: Reserved Slots
variables.description: Out of Max Players, this many slots are held for players at or above the permission level below.

variables.name: Reserved Slots Permission Level
variables.description: Permission level (0 = highest) required to use a reserved slot.

variables.name: Admin Slots
variables.description: Extra slots on top of Max Players that only admins can use to join a full server.

variables.name: Admin Slots Permission Level
variables.description: Permission level (0 = highest) required to use an admin slot.

variables.name: Disabled Network Protocols
variables.description: Networking protocols to turn off, comma separated. Values: LiteNetLib, SteamNetworking. Disable SteamNetworking if port-forwarding is set up correctly or there's no NAT router between you and your players.

variables.name: World Download Speed Limit (KiB/s)
variables.description: Caps how fast the world is sent to a client connecting without a copy of it yet. About 1300 is the practical maximum even if you set higher.

variables.name: Easy Anti-Cheat
variables.description: Set to true to enable EasyAntiCheat. Required for crossplay. Most DLL/Harmony mods require this to be false.

variables.name: Allow Crossplay
variables.description: Set to true to let PC, PlayStation and Xbox players join together. Requires Easy Anti-Cheat on, no mods, and Max Players at 8 or below.

variables.name: Ignore Epic Online Services Bans
variables.description: Set to true to let players join even if Epic Online Services has sanctioned their account.

variables.name: Persistent Player Profiles
variables.description: Set to true to make a player rejoin with the same profile they used last time. Set to false to let them pick a different one each time they connect.

variables.name: World
variables.description: Navezgane (the hand-built map), RWG (randomly generated, see World Seed/Size below), or the exact name of a custom map already in the Worlds folder.

variables.name: World Seed
variables.description: Seed used to generate the world when World is set to RWG. Ignored otherwise.

variables.name: World Size
variables.description: Width and height in metres of a generated RWG world. Must be a multiple of 2048, from 2048 to 16384. Larger takes longer to generate, download and load.

variables.name: Save Name
variables.description: Internal save name. Changing this starts a brand new save the next time the server boots - it is not the name players see (that's Server Name above).

variables.name: Game Mode
variables.description: Game mode. GameModeSurvival is currently the only mode dedicated servers support.

variables.name: Sandbox Code
variables.description: Encodes every difficulty, loot, zombie and world-rule setting (150 options as of V3.1). Generated in-game from the Sandbox Options menu, or the official preset codes - this cannot be typed by hand. The default is the equivalent of the old Adventurer difficulty.

variables.name: Safe Zone Player Level
variables.description: New players at or below this level get a temporary no-enemy safe zone around their spawn.

variables.name: Safe Zone Duration (in-game hours)
variables.description: How many in-game hours the safe zone above lasts.

variables.name: Creative Mode For Everyone
variables.description: Set to true to give every player creative-mode building and unlimited resources. Flags the server as Modded in the browser.

variables.name: Bedroll No-Spawn Radius
variables.description: Radius in blocks around a bedroll where zombies will not spawn.

variables.name: Bedroll Expiry (real days)
variables.description: Real-world days a bedroll stays claimed after its owner was last online.

variables.name: Max Zombies (whole map)
variables.description: Hard cap on zombies alive anywhere on the map at once. The single biggest performance lever on this list.

variables.name: Max Animals (whole map)
variables.description: Hard cap on wildlife alive anywhere on the map at once. Costs much less CPU per animal than a zombie.

variables.name: Max View Distance
variables.description: Largest view distance a client is allowed to request, from 6 to 12. Big effect on server memory and CPU.

variables.name: Max Revealed Map Area Per Player
variables.description: Caps how many in-game map chunks each player can uncover, which also caps their map file size. The default allows about 32 km² per player.

variables.name: Player Killing
variables.description: Who players are allowed to kill. 0 = no PvP, 1 = allies can kill each other, 2 = strangers can kill each other, 3 = everyone can kill everyone.

variables.name: Party Shared XP Range (metres)
variables.description: How close party members must be to share kill XP and party quest credit.

variables.name: Land Claims: Max Per Player
variables.description: Maximum land claims (keystones) a single player can place.

variables.name: Land Claims: Protected Size (blocks)
variables.description: Size in blocks of the area a keystone protects.

variables.name: Land Claims: Minimum Spacing (blocks)
variables.description: Minimum distance in blocks required between two keystones, unless the owners are friends.

variables.name: Land Claims: Expire After (real days)
variables.description: Real-world days a player can stay offline before their claim expires and loses protection.

variables.name: Land Claims: Offline Decay
variables.description: How a claim's protection fades while its owner is offline. 0 = slow (linear), 1 = fast (exponential), 2 = none (full protection until it expires).

variables.name: Land Claims: Block Hardness (owner online)
variables.description: Multiplies block hardness inside a claim while its owner is online. 0 means the blocks cannot be damaged at all.

variables.name: Land Claims: Block Hardness (owner offline)
variables.description: Same as above, but while the owner is offline.

variables.name: Land Claims: Offline Grace Period (minutes)
variables.description: Minutes after a player logs out before their claim's hardness switches from the online to the offline modifier above.

variables.name: Dynamic Mesh (Building Collapse)
variables.description: Set to true to let damaged structures visually deform and collapse instead of staying rigid.

variables.name: Dynamic Mesh: Land Claims Only
variables.description: Set to true to limit dynamic mesh physics to areas inside a land claim, saving performance everywhere else.

variables.name: Dynamic Mesh: Land Claim Buffer (chunks)
variables.description: How many extra chunks around a land claim also get dynamic mesh physics.

variables.name: Dynamic Mesh: Max Concurrent Items
variables.description: How many dynamic mesh items can process at once. Higher uses more RAM.

variables.name: Telnet
variables.description: Set to true to enable the Telnet remote console (this is what the panel console uses to talk to the server).

variables.name: Telnet Password
variables.description: Password for the Telnet console. Leave blank to only allow connections from localhost (safe default - the panel console still works either way).

variables.name: Telnet Failed Login Limit
variables.description: How many wrong passwords from one remote address before it gets blocked.

variables.name: Telnet Login Block Time (seconds)
variables.description: How long a blocked address stays blocked after too many failed Telnet logins.

variables.name: Web Dashboard
variables.description: Set to true to enable the built-in browser-based admin dashboard.

variables.name: Web Dashboard Port
variables.description: Port the web dashboard listens on. Only matters if Web Dashboard is enabled.

variables.name: Web Map Rendering
variables.description: Set to true to render explored-map tiles for the web dashboard's map view.

variables.name: Hide Command Execution Log
variables.description: How much of the command log is hidden. 0 = log every command, 1 = hide Telnet/dashboard commands, 2 = also hide remote in-game commands, 3 = hide everything.

variables.name: Admin List Filename
variables.description: Filename of the admin/permissions list, inside your save folder.

variables.name: Twitch Integration Permission Level
variables.description: Permission level (0 = highest) required to use Twitch chat integration on this server.

variables.name: Allow Twitch Events During Blood Moon
variables.description: Set to true to let viewers' Twitch actions spawn extra zombies during a blood moon. Can add server lag.
